activation.method: A reviewed pull request changes enabled to true after every required evidence item is linked below.
activation.reviewers: At least one repository maintainer reviews activation and repository release settings.

requiredEvidence.requirement: The complete documented public API is implemented, generated inventory coverage is current, and every documented operation has exercised local acceptance evidence.
All supported authentication flows are implemented and locally accepted, including invalid, expired, and revoked credential behavior.
All documented profile selection, persistence, isolation, and migration behavior is implemented and locally accepted.
Destructive and sensitive operations have their documented confirmation, error, redaction, and non-interactive safety behavior, proven by local acceptance evidence.
A local release plan and GoReleaser snapshot have been inspected for all six target archives, checksum output, embedded build metadata, and installation smoke behavior.
